mapper.select: SELECT d.department_id AS id, d.department_name AS name FROM employee e JOIN department d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.department_id = e.department_id WHERE e.company_id = #{companyId} AND e.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND d.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.sql:
FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = p.company_id AND e.employee_id = p.author_employee_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_DEPT' AND b.department_id = #{departmentId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y'
AND (p.title LIKE '%' || #{w} || '%' OR p.content LIKE '%' || #{w} || '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_id AS id, p.title AS title, e.employee_name AS writerName, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_comment c WHERE c.company_id = p.company_id AND c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_file f WHERE f.company_id = p.company_id AND f.post_id = p.post_id) AS fileCount
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.post_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.post_id AS id, p.title AS title, p.content AS content, p.author_employee_id AS authorId, e.employee_name AS writerName, TO_CHAR(p.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createdAt, CASE WHEN p.updated_at > p.created_at + INTERVAL '1' SECOND THEN TO_CHAR(p.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS updatedAt FROM post p JOIN board b ON b.company_id = p.company_id AND b.board_id = p.board_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = p.company_id AND e.employee_id = p.author_employee_id WHERE p.company_id = #{companyId} AND p.post_id = #{postId} AND b.board_type = 'BOARD_DEPT' AND b.department_id = #{departmentId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visible_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (company_id, board_name, board_type, department_id) VALUES (#{companyId}, '부서 게시판', 'BOARD_DEPT', #{departmentId})

INSERT INTO post (post_id, company_id, board_id, author_employee_id, title, content, status_code) VALUES (#{postId}, #{companyId}, #{boardId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, 'POST_PUBLISHED')
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE post SET deleted_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP), status_code = 'POST_REMOVED'
